description: Delegate work to a running LibrAgent desktop/headless instance via the local HTTP Session API (`POST /api/sessions`, messages, status, children, resume, terminate, delete). Use from Cursor (or other external harnesses) when LibrAgent is up and you need a LibrAgent session to run a task — optionally with `parentSessionId` lineage. After work: extract message history (session transcript / API-side "trace"), then terminate+delete one-shot sessions. Triggers: Session API, /api/sessions, parentSessionId, curl session, HTTP delegate to LibrAgent, "LibrAgent에 위임", "세션 API로 자식 띄워", Harbor/bench spawn, session cleanup, delete session, extract transcript. NEVER for LibrAgent-internal `agent__spawnSession` flows (that is the in-app `delegate` skill). NEVER invent MCP tool names here.
